applicabilityConditions.additionalInfo: *The Bonus Intro Rate is the current standard variable rate plus a 4 month Bonus Intro Rate, and applies only on balances up to $100,000. The standard variable rate applies to amounts over $100,000.To qualify, new members must open an Online Saver account with a linked eligible account within sixty (60) days of membership opening. An eligible account means a Simply Access (S1), Pension Plus (S65) or Business Access (S13) account. The Bonus Intro Rate applies for 4 months starting on the day the online saver account is opened, after which the Bonus Intro Rate will no longer apply. The Bonus Intro Rate is available only to new members, and is limited to one (1) online saver (S26) account per member (either as a joint or single account holder).

fees.additionalInfo: Applies as a fee on establishment of each new staff assisted external electronic payment . Includes staff assisted transfers to a Heritage account. Where the staff assisted transfer is a recurring payment or debit, the fee will only apply to the first successful transfer (and will not apply to subseuent recurrent transfers), unless the recurring payment is amended.

fees.name: Corporate Cheque
fees.additionalInfo: Charged each time a Corporate Cheque is issued.

fees.name: Direct Debit Dishonour
fees.additionalInfo: Applies when your account has insufficient funds to cover the amount of a direct debit. Charged on the day the direct debit is attempted. Not charged if Honour Fee is payable.

fees.name: Others
fees.additionalInfo: All People's Choice Credit Union Fees and Charges are referenced within the disclosure document linked below.

fees.name: Emergency same day transfer
fees.additionalInfo: Applies for when a new staff assisted same day transfer external or Heritage electronic payment is debited from your account.

fees.name: Direct Debit Dishonour Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Applies when your account has insufficient funds to cover the amount of a direct debit.

fees.name: Frequent Statement Fee
fees.additionalInfo: This fee applies to members who request a statement more regularly than the statement cycle specified in the Summary of Term Investment Accounts table in Chapter 7. Excludes eStatements, which are free of charge.

fees.name: Duplicate/replacement Statement
fees.additionalInfo: Applies when you request us to provide a copy of a statement that has already been issued (including where you request a paper copy of an eStatement). Charged at the time the statement is requested.

fees.name: Access Token
fees.additionalInfo: Applies for each active Access Token. Charged upon issue.

fees.name: Overdrawn Administration Fee 1
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you overdraw your account without an approved overdraft or line of credit and you fail to deposit funds to the account to clear all overdrawn amounts within 7 days of us notifying you that your account is overdrawn.

fees.name: Overdrawn Administration Fee 2
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you overdraw your account without an approved overdraft or line of credit and your account remains overdrawn for a period of 20 days or more.

fees.name: Qucik Debit Dishonour
fees.additionalInfo: Applies when your account with another financial institution or your account with Heritage has insufficient funds to cover the value of the quick debit request. Quick Debit services available only on application and on select products.

fees.name: Dormant (inactive fee)
fees.additionalInfo: Applies when you do not have any activity on your account/s or membership, we may charge you a fee at the time we close your inactive accounts.

fees.name: Direct Debit Honour
fees.additionalInfo: Applies when a direct debit is paid from your account where insufficient funds are available.

fees.name: Paper Statement Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Applies to each paper statement issued as per the statement cycle specified. Excludes eStatements which are free of charge.

features.additionalValue: One to One Relationship Management available

This is achieved by providing each member with their own Relationship Manager as a single point of contact for all their financial service needs.
